ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels in the central lobes and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the lateral lobes. These are bisected by a vertical black band at the median notch and framed by thick, irregular black borders. High-frequency black mottling is concentrated on the inner medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 62 degrees and a significant depth ratio relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (1-5 pixels) forming a jagged topography along the entire length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately convex sweep that transitions into sharp, acute-angled lateral tips (fluke tips).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-contrast black pixel clusters (mottling) on the inner white field of the left lobe. A distinct reddish-brown cluster of high-contrast textured pixels is visible on the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) is visible on the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe's white field, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant localized accumulation of brownish-red textured pixels on the extreme right fluke tip, consistent with barnacle colonization or localized trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The black pigmentation pattern at the convergence of the lobes and the peduncle forms a distinctive anchor-like or 'T' shape.
